content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to propose a few minor adjustments: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", payment is due in 40 days, which is later than the standard 30 days and creates a cash flow delay for you. I propose changing this so that invoices are payable Net 30. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
